explanations.empty: Select a role to see the permissions it grants.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Full control over the organization, including billing, integrations, teams, users and policies.
creator.communityDescription: Full control over the organization: integrations, teams, users and policies.

administrator.title: Administrator
administrator.description: Full control over the organization identical to a Creator, including billing, integrations, teams, users and policies.
administrator.communityDescription: Full control over the organization identical to a Creator: integrations, teams, users and policies.

manager.title: Manager
manager.description: Can manage integrations, invite or remove members and create teams. No billing access and cannot delete policies.
manager.communityDescription: Can manage integrations, invite or remove members and create teams. Cannot delete policies.

billing_manager.title: Billing Manager
billing_manager.description: Read-only access to the organization plus full control over billing settings.

member.title: Member
member.description: Read-only access to the organization, its users and its policies.

team_manager.title: Team Manager
team_manager.description: Manages the team: members, roles, projects, reports and policy violations.

analyst_developer.title: Analyst Developer
analyst_developer.description: Runs scans, triages vulnerabilities and creates or reads reports across the team projects.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Runs scans and updates vulnerability states on the team projects.

read_only.title: Read Only
read_only.description: Read-only access to the team, its effective policies and compliance history.

permissions.read: View the organization, its teams and its projects
permissions.billing: Access and manage billing, plans and invoices
permissions.manage_integration: Connect and manage integrations (GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Slack, registries)
permissions.manage: Change the organization settings and administrative data
permissions.update_user_role: Change the roles of other members
permissions.add_user: Invite new members to the organization
permissions.create_project: Create new projects inside the team
permissions.read_scan_result: View scan results across the team projects
permissions.change_vulnerability_state: Triage vulnerabilities (confirm, reject, mark as false positive)
permissions.start_scan: Trigger scans on the team projects
permissions.read_effective_policy: View the effective policy resolved for a project
permissions.read_compliance_history: View the compliance history of the team
permissions.read_policy_violation: View policy violations on the team projects
